name: print-social-halftone-thanks-slide-ransom-letters-and-window
title: Thanks slide with ransom letters, chrome exclamation mark and app window on halftone hills
whatItIs: A halftoned blue sky and green hills backdrop with a grey app window carrying a black torn-paper title 'Thanks' in mismatched colourful letters, followed by a silver chrome exclamation mark, surrounded by Figma, Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, Procreate and After Effects icons and a translucent trash can.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and nostalgic; a chrome punctuation mark adds a shiny modern twist.
techniques: Put a torn black shape behind multicolour letters for high contrast.
Add a glossy chrome 3D object as punctuation.
Frame the title inside a fake window with traffic-light buttons.
Scatter tool icons around as skill tags.

vocabulary.definition: A drawn app window used as a frame.
A ragged dark shape behind text.
App icons spread around a central element.
